header.name: Introduction To The Study Of Literature
header.description:
1. Develop and encourage the students to grow and evolve through the literary journey 2. Expose the students to a range of literary genres (involving both fiction and non-fiction): poetry, drama, novel and short story
3. Introduce the students to a wide range of writings of authors from different cultures and ages across the world
4. To sensitise students to some of the important common social issues which writers of different backgrounds, cultures, and mediums have examined.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: The student understands how literature provides a window to comprehend the society.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: The student is able to interpret texts using the process of literary analysis for all the 3 main literary genres namely prose, poetry and drama

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: The student is able to appreciate what makes a work of literature worthy and important -common social issues which authors in spite of their different backgrounds often examined.

lecture_topics: Introduction to the Study of literature
brief overview
How does literature provide a window to the society and what what makes it worthy
How did Literature evolve
Kinds of different Literary genres
Discussion on writings of authors from diffrent cultures and ages across the globe
Literary devices of a Short Story
Two Specific Texts (short stories) of American Literature to be discussed - The Yellow Wall Paper by Charlotte Perkins Gilman and The Story of An Hour by Kate Chopin
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Read the link of the specified short story

lecture_topics: Evolution of poetry
what makes it different from prose
Discussion on the themes of specific texts of few selected short poems
Novel- its evolution
Discussion on few award-winning novels and the common social issues which authors, inspite of their different backgrounds have examined
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students read a novel of their choice and are required to submit the assignment based on it.

lecture_topics: Discussion of Specific Texts eg. Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen, Autobiography of Frederick Douglass etc.
